name: membraince
description: Long-term memory for Claude Code: recalls what matters when a session starts and with each prompt, saves what you tell Claude, and learns where code lives in each repository.

api_key.title: MemBraince API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://membraince.com/portal (starts with mb_live_).

user_id.title: Memory owner
user_id.description: Whose memories these are, inside your account. Use a different value to keep separate memories for different people or agents.

auto_recall.title: Recall automatically
auto_recall.description: Add relevant memories when a session starts and with each prompt. Each prompt makes one search request.

auto_save.title: Save automatically
auto_save.description: Before compaction and when a session ends, save the messages you typed, plus Claude's file reads, edits and commands when Learn the repository is on. Each save is billed per your plan.

learn_code.title: Learn the repository
learn_code.description: Also save the files Claude reads and edits and the commands it runs, so later sessions start knowing where code is and how it's tested. Files named like secrets (.env, keys) are never sent.

project.title: Project
project.description: Optional. A project name from the portal to save to and recall from. Leave empty to save to the key's home project and recall from every project linked to the key.
